people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
translations.bsb: All of you are standing today before the LORD your God—you leaders of tribes, elders, officials, and all the men of Israel,
translations.kjv: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
translations.asv: Ye stand this day all of you before Jehovah your God; your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
